test.query: SELECT EventDate, TraficSourceID, count() FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY EventDate, TraficSourceID FORMAT Null
SELECT toHour(EventTime) AS h, OS, count() FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY h, OS FORMAT Null
SELECT SearchEngineID, AdvEngineID, count() FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY SearchEngineID, AdvEngineID FORMAT Null
SELECT EventDate, TraficSourceID, count(), sum(WindowClientWidth), avg(WindowClientHeight) FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY EventDate, TraficSourceID FORMAT Null
SELECT toUInt16(intHash32(number) % 50) AS a, toUInt16(intHash32(number + 1) % 32) AS b, count() FROM numbers_mt(100000000) GROUP BY a, b FORMAT Null
SELECT toUInt16(intHash32(number) % 50) AS a, toUInt16(intHash32(number + 1) % 80) AS b, count() FROM numbers_mt(100000000) GROUP BY a, b FORMAT Null
SELECT toDate('2024-01-01') + intDiv(number, 273973) AS d, toUInt16(intHash32(number) % 500) AS p, count() FROM numbers_mt(100000000) GROUP BY d, p FORMAT Null
SELECT number % 60000 AS a, toUInt8(number % 7) AS b, count() FROM numbers_mt(100000000) GROUP BY a, b FORMAT Null
